reason: This is framed as a refactor, but it moves two central logical operators (`LogicalJoin`, `LogicalSelection`) across the planner core and touches a very broad set of optimizer, costing, decorrelation, predicate pushdown, join reordering, plan building, plan-to-PB, and executor join paths. Even if intended to be semantics-preserving, the blast radius is high in exactly the planner/executor areas where subtle Blocker/High regressions can hide.
